Edit ONLY the clothes of the first image: dress him in EXACTLY the same red hoodie and beige chino pants as the second image — same colors, same shading style, same hood and front pocket; the long sleeves must follow the existing arm poses exactly, hands stay bare skin. Keep everything else of the first image EXACTLY pixel-identical: the same face, eyes, hair, skin, shoes, body pose, arm and leg positions, framing, and green background.」.
